preconditions.description: The number of intersections is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The number of roads is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each pair of intersections is connected by no more than one road.
preconditions.description: There is at most one road between any two intersections.

preconditions.expression: No road connects the intersection to itself.
preconditions.description: No road has both ends at the same intersection.

postconditions.expression: output == 'YES' ==> (next(output) == '3' and next(output) == 'l1 p1 ... pl1' and next(output) == 'l2 p1 ... pl2' and next(output) == 'l3 p1 ... pl3')
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', then it is followed by three lines with the descriptions of the three routes.
If the output is 'NO', then there are no further lines of output.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in p1 ... pl1) and all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in p1 ... pl2) and all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in p1 ... pl3)
invariants.description: The route descriptions contain only valid intersection numbers.

invariants.expression: all(1 < pi <= n for pi in p1 ... pl1) and all(1 < pi <= n for pi in p1 ... pl2) and all(1 < pi <= n for pi in p1 ... pl3)
invariants.description: The start and finish intersections of each route are distinct and not the same as any other route's start or finish.

invariants.expression: all(pi != pj for pi in p1 ... pl1 for pj in p1 ... pl2) and all(pi != pj for pi in p1 ... pl1 for pj in p1 ... pl3) and all(pi != pj for pi in p1 ... pl2 for pj in p1 ... pl3)
invariants.description: No two routes share any junctions except the start and finish.

invariants.expression: all(pi != pj for pi in range(1, n+1) for pj in range(1, n+1) if pi != pj and (pi, pj) in roads and (pj, pi) in roads)
invariants.description: No route visits the same road more than once.

invariants.expression: all(pi != pj for pi in range(1, n+1) for pj in range(1, n+1) if pi != pj and (pi, pj) in roads and (pj, pi) in roads)
invariants.description: No route visits the same intersection more than twice.
